title: U-2 Missions 2013 and 2014 (4-5 July 1956) route map with Leningrad and Moscow photos
description: Map of northern Europe and the western USSR tracing "Mission 2013 4 July" (solid line) and "Mission 2014 5 July" (dashed line) from Wiesbaden across Poland and Belorussia toward Leningrad, Minsk and Moscow (with Khimki and Ramenskoye marked). Below the map are two U-2 aerial photographs captioned "U-2 photography of Leningrad, 4 July 1956" and "Fili Airframe Plant, Moscow, 5 July 1956." Marked "Secret NOFORN" with handwritten page number "103."
